request.style: English, solo female voice, fiddle, bodhran, harp, flute, celtic folk, serene, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The book of Luke lists the names in a row
Jesus began his work, about thirty years old
As was supposed, he was the son of Joseph
Son of Heli, and son of Matthat
Levi followed, and Melchi, and Jannai
The list goes on, through Joseph and Mattathias
Amos and Nahum, and Esli, and Naggai
Maath and Mattathias, and Semein, and Josech

[Chorus]
Jonam is the link, the son of Eliakim
Between the fathers and the sons yet to come
A name in the register, a part of the whole
In the line of David, faithful and true

[Verse]
Joanan and Rhesa, Zerubbabel and Shealtiel
Neri and Melchi, Addi, Cosam, Elmadam
Er and Joshua, Eliezer, Jorim, Matthat
Levi and Simeon, Judah, Joseph, and Jonam

[Chorus]
Jonam is the link, the son of Eliakim
Between the fathers and the sons yet to come
A name in the register, a part of the whole
In the line of David, faithful and true

[Verse]
Melea and Menna, Mattatha and Nathan
The son of David, the son of Jesse, Obed
Boaz and Sala, Nahshon and Amminadab
Admin and Arni, Hezron, Perez, Judah

[Chorus]
Jonam is the link, the son of Eliakim
Between the fathers and the sons yet to come
A name in the register, a part of the whole
In the line of David, faithful and true

[Bridge]
When days are done, and you rest with your fathers
I will raise up your offspring, establish his kingdom
He will build a house for my name
And I will establish his throne forever

[Outro]
From Adam to Jesus, the promise stands
Jonam in the genealogy, in God's own hands
